headline: Nigerian Exchange Market Capitalization Reaches Record N165.11 Trillion
summary: Equity trading on the Nigerian Exchange Limited closed on a peak note with total equities market capitalization rising by N140.55 billion to hit an all-time high of N165.11 trillion.
why: Overall market capitalization gauges the total value of publicly traded equities, reflecting investor sentiment and capital inflows into a country's stock exchange.
why_moved: An addition of N140.55 billion drove total capitalization to a record high, reflecting strong buying pressure in Nigerian equities.
